title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Explore Brandeis University's best free social spots and activities, from world-class art galleries to serene campus trails and late-night student hubs.

cards.title: Browse Modern Masterpieces
cards.subtitle: Free Contemporary Art Gallery
cards.notes: Visit the museum's galleries to see rotating exhibitions of modern and contemporary art. Admission is always free for students and the public.
cards.short_summary: A premier contemporary art museum on campus offering free admission to all visitors.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rose Art Museum is open to all with free admission and is committed to providing a respectful, safe, and inclusive experience.
cards.source_title: Hours and Admission | Visit | Rose Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday through Sunday, 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. Closed Mondays and Tuesdays.

cards.title: Hang Out in the SCC Atrium
cards.subtitle: The Heart of Student Life
cards.notes: Relax on updated lounge furniture or meet friends in this central hub. It is card-accessible 24 hours a day for Brandeis students.
cards.short_summary: A central campus gathering space with 24-hour student access and comfortable lounge seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The SCC (the big green building by Fellows Garden) is also card-accessible 24 hours. There's a variety of seating options across all three floors.
cards.source_title: Shapiro Campus Center | Visiting Student Engagement Spaces
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours for students with valid ID swipe access.

cards.title: Hike the Sachar Woods Trails
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Nature Escape
cards.notes: Explore a mile-long network of dirt trails in the forest behind the International Business School. Look for the 'mysterious bench' for a quiet reading spot.
cards.short_summary: A wooded trail system on the edge of campus perfect for hiking and quiet reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Brandeis owns and maintains a little-known mile-long dirt trail network in the forest behind the International Business School.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible during daylight hours; located behind the IBS building.

cards.title: Work Out at Gosman
cards.subtitle: Free Student Fitness Access
cards.notes: Use the indoor pool, basketball courts, and weight room for free with your student ID. Check the schedule for open lap swim times.
cards.short_summary: A massive athletic complex offering free gym and pool access to all current Brandeis students.
cards.evidence_claim: All current Brandeis students, faculty, and staff, may use the athletic facilities free of charge. A valid Brandeis ID card must be presented.
cards.source_title: Facility Memberships and Guest Policies - Brandeis University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open daily; typical hours are 7am-11pm Mon-Thu, with shorter weekend hours.

cards.title: Join a Shabbat Dinner
cards.subtitle: Weekly Community Meals
cards.notes: Experience a four-course gourmet dinner at the Chein family home. These weekly gatherings are open to all students regardless of observance level.
cards.short_summary: Weekly gourmet Shabbat dinners hosted for the student community at no cost.
cards.evidence_claim: Weekly gourmet Shabbat dinners... where students unwind, connect, and engage in meaningful conversations around the week's theme.
cards.access_notes: Held weekly on Friday evenings; open to all Brandeis students.

cards.title: Stroll Through the Light of Reason
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Sculpture Garden
cards.notes: Walk through Chris Burden's installation of 24 Victorian lampposts outside the Rose Art Museum. It's a popular spot for photos and evening walks.
cards.short_summary: An iconic outdoor art installation featuring illuminated antique lampposts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Class of 2023 gathered at Chris Burden's 'Light of Reason' installation outside the Rose Art Museum for an annual tradition.
cards.source_title: First-years unite at Light the Night | BrandeisNOW
cards.access_notes: Outdoor installation accessible 24/7; lights are typically on in the evening.

cards.title: Reflect by the Three Chapels
cards.subtitle: Peaceful Waterside Spot
cards.notes: Sit by the pond adjacent to the Berlin, Bethlehem, and Harlan chapels. It is a quiet area ideal for meditation or reading between classes.
cards.short_summary: A serene pond area surrounded by the university's three interfaith chapels.
cards.evidence_claim: Located on Chapels Pond, adjacent to Chapels Field, the space is automatically open to all Brandeis students via swipe access.
cards.source_title: Catholic Chapel | Sacred Places | Center for Spiritual Life
cards.access_notes: Outdoor area open 24/7; chapels typically open 5 a.m. to 11 p.m. for students.

cards.title: Play Trivia at The Stein
cards.subtitle: Late Night Socializing
cards.notes: Join the weekly Trivia Thursdays from 9-11pm. It's a free social event where students compete in teams for bragging rights and fun.
cards.short_summary: A popular weekly trivia event held in the campus restaurant and social space.
cards.evidence_claim: Trivia Thursdays, 9-11pm, The Stein. Campus Programs and Traditions.
cards.source_title: Back to Brandeis and Winter Welcome | Campus Programs and Traditions
cards.access_notes: Trivia is held on Thursday nights; open to all students.

cards.title: Study with a View
cards.subtitle: Quiet Collaborative Space
cards.notes: Book a group study room or find a quiet corner on the mezzanine. It's a reliable spot for late-night productivity with easy access to resources.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated library level featuring group study rooms and individual workspaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Group study rooms are located on the Farber Mezzanine and on Goldfarb 1. Please use our booking page to reserve a group study room.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | Rooms and Spaces | Library
cards.access_notes: Library hours vary; typically open until 2 a.m. most nights during the semester.

cards.title: Attend Mindful Moments
cards.subtitle: Weekly Guided Meditation
cards.notes: Join these half-hour meditation sessions led by staff and students. They are approachable, open to everyone, and designed to help de-stress.
cards.short_summary: Free weekly mindfulness and meditation sessions open to the entire campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Mindful Moments are half-hour gatherings that include staff- and student-led meditations, approachable and open to everyone on campus.
cards.source_title: Offerings and Events | Center for Spiritual Life
cards.access_notes: Weekly sessions; check the Center for Spiritual Life calendar for current times.
